final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Pods listing shows only currencyservice-6c5cd895d9-wszxs as an outlier: RESTARTS=5 (45s ago) vs 0 for all other 10 boutique pods. Its last termination state is Terminated/Reason=Error/Exit Code=137 after only ~8s of life, and kubelet events bind the mechanism literally: 'Liveness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.1.147:7000" within 1s: context deadline exceeded' followed by 'Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' (x3) and 'Back-off restarting failed container server', i.e. kubelet SIGKILLed the container — Reason is Error, not OOMKilled. The deployment config is the breakpoint: livenessProbe grpc:7000 with initialDelaySeconds=1, periodSeconds=1, timeoutSeconds=1, failureThreshold=1, whereas the app logs show gRPC listens only ~2s after container start (15:44:21 Started -> 15:44:23 'CurrencyService gRPC server started on port 7000'), so the first probe always times out and a single failure kills the container. Peer baseline adservice (also gRPC) uses initialDelaySeconds=5 with default period 10s/timeout 1s/failureThreshold 3 and has 0 restarts. Probe port 7000 matches containerPort/PORT=7000 and Service port 7000->targetPort 7000 with correct grpc protocol, ruling out port/protocol faults; no scheduling, image-pull, mount, or serviceaccount failures appear in namespace events, and no metric alerts exist. Corroborating: currencyservice has no endpoint address in the Endpoints list while all other services do, and CheckServiceConnectivity(currencyservice:7000) failed from all nodes — consistent with a pod cycling out of Ready under repeated probe-driven kills.
